title: Post-war Nazi network Die Spinne in the Arab world

plain: A writer and researcher named Jason Jorjani, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that after the Second World War there was an international network of former Nazis, which some people call Die Spinne, German for "the spider", and that it reached into the Arab world. He says he builds on the work of another researcher, Joseph Farrell, and sets it out in his book. If true, it would mean Nazi remnants kept organising across borders long after the war ended.
